purpose: Supplement Run61 with primary institutional, stablecoin, escrow and payment-rail evidence.

rlUSD.issuer: Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC, a Ripple subsidiary and NYDFS limited-purpose trust company

issuer_transparency.classification: issuer-published balance; not the latest CPA attestation report

latest_cpa_attestation.accountant: Deloitte & Touche LLP per Ripple transparency page
eligible_asset_types: US Treasury bills with 3 months or less to maturity
overnight reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by US Treasuries
US bank deposits at FDIC-insured institutions or custodians approved by NYDFS

xrpl_dex.large_issuer_payments: No issuer payment >=100,000 RLUSD found in the latest 100 issuer account transactions; this does not establish zero payments below the threshold or outside that page.

quality_notes: Direct chain reads and DefiLlama disagree by 20.37M RLUSD, mainly on XRPL; preserve both rather than average.
Issuer transparency balances are as of Nov 5; latest CPA report listed is Sep 30 and signed Oct 26. Do not label the Nov 5 balance as independently attested.
StableRadar is a prototype with partly live and partly reference data; use the Ripple issuer transparency page and signed PDF for reserve claims.
RLUSD supply, reserve balances and RLUSD collateral are not XRP demand or XRP collateral.

ripple_prime_rwa_perps.markets: 100+ reference markets across equities, indices, ETFs, metals, energy and FX
ripple_prime_rwa_perps.model: Ripple Prime acts as principal; clients can cross-margin exposures against other Ripple Prime asset classes
ripple_prime_rwa_perps.xrp_collateral: not stated; do not infer XRP collateral

ripple_coinbase_rlusd.status: RLUSD live on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail
ripple_coinbase_rlusd.conversion: 1:1 conversion from USD and other supported USD-denominated stablecoins
ripple_coinbase_rlusd.future: Coinbase Global Exchange availability including RLUSD collateral support to follow; not verified live

ripple_robinhood.live: RLUSD on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood
ripple_robinhood.xrpl: Robinhood intends to use RLUSD on XRPL for institutional settlement
ripple_robinhood.treasury: Ripple Treasury integration for cash/liquidity management, forecasting, payments, risk and intercompany netting
ripple_robinhood.prime: Ripple Prime provides Bitstamp by Robinhood lending and margin financing across roughly 20 digital assets and spot access; perpetual futures planned later in 2026
ripple_robinhood.xrp_demand: XRPL institutional settlement is not proof that XRP is the settlement asset in every flow

ripple_occ_trust_bank.status: final OCC approval to establish Ripple National Trust Bank
approved_scope: act as collateral trustee for RLUSD reserves
provide fiduciary digital-asset custody upon opening
ripple_occ_trust_bank.issuer: RLUSD continues to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, NYDFS limited-purpose trust company
ripple_occ_trust_bank.reserve_custodian: BNY is named by Ripple as primary reserve custodian
ripple_occ_trust_bank.distinction: final charter approval is not evidence that the national trust bank has opened or begun operating; not a commercial deposit bank

standard_chartered_lmax.custody: RLUSD custody on XRPL is live through Standard Chartered's DIFC branch regulated by DFSA
standard_chartered_lmax.lmax_collateral_mirroring: planned; subject to documentation, testing, regulatory requirements and internal approvals

circle_arc.network: Arc, Circle's independent Layer-1 public blockchain
circle_arc.privacy: opt-in privacy in development for network-wide release
circle_arc.payments: Circle Payments Network integrated natively; Circle StableFX offers 24/7 cross-currency settlement
circle_arc.jpySC_nuance: SBI's CEO said SBI expects to leverage both USDC and JPYSC in its Arc collaboration, but JPYSC was not on Circle's enumerated active/onboarding StableFX list in the launch release. No live JPYSC-on-Arc integration verified.
circle_arc.agentic_claim: Circle says USDC accounts for 98.8% of agent-driven x402 transaction volume; company claim, not independently audited here.
circle_arc.implication: Arc is a parallel stablecoin/payment/financial-market rail. SBI Group and Standard Chartered participate in both Arc and Ripple-related initiatives; participation is not exclusive and Arc is not an XRP Ledger deployment.

circle_q3_2026.tazapay_acquisition: definitive agreement; expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approval; Tazapay reports $25B+ annualized volume, 60+ partners and payout rails in 100+ markets
circle_q3_2026.other_distribution: Visa Direct stablecoin prefunding moved from pilots to commercial deployment with USDC via Inyo Global; Samsung Wallet USDC remittance support to bank accounts in 60+ countries
circle_q3_2026.caveat: Circle's other revenue includes $182M ARC token presale; adjusted EBITDA growth is not solely recurring USDC reserve economics. Reserve income declined 8% despite 8% higher average USDC circulation, with a 61bp lower reserve return rate.

JPYSC_usage_as_of_2026_11_02.classification: SBI VC Trade company-reported balances; not XRP flows

tokenized_mmf_mou.status: basic agreement/MOU to link tokenized money-market funds and JPYSC; not production integration

arc.role: SBI Group named as an Arc founding validator and stated it intends to leverage USDC and JPYSC in APAC infrastructure

sbi.relationship_graph: SBI Group is simultaneously connected to Ripple (historical equity and SBI Ripple Asia/Evernorth relationships), Circle (USDC distribution and Arc founding validator), and Startale/BlackRock JPYSC-tokenized MMF work. These are parallel strategic relationships, not proof of exclusive XRP alignment.

ripple_escrow.source_method: XRP Insights says it queries rippled account_objects/account_tx on a pinned validated ledger, counting Ripple-owned escrow objects once.
ripple_escrow.interpretation: Unlock/relock data describes ledger time-lock movement, not sales, exchange inflows, free float or immediate market supply.

source_independence.direct_chain_reads: StableRadar's live supply page reads XRPL gateway_balances and EVM totalSupply; it also displays a separate DefiLlama column. These are not identical datasets.
source_independence.issuer_report: Ripple transparency page reports Nov 5 balances; signed CPA report covers Sep 21 and Sep 30.
source_independence.official_corporate_announcements: Circle, Ripple and SBI releases establish announced product/partner status, not independent usage volumes.
source_independence.company_claims: Circle's agent volume and Q3 operating metrics are issuer disclosures.
source_independence.raw_receipts: No Barrot RawReceiptArchive receipts were created for these web observations.

Ripple National Trust Bank final OCC approval
